title: Panda Adventure enemy taxonomy configuration
description: Authoritative config for the S4 Enemy taxonomy (gADR-0000, gADR-0003), the S6a per-Tier Kill reward table (gADR-0004), and the S5 Wave schedule (gADR-0005). `tiers` maps each Tier to its reward budget ({exp_reward, gold_reward, drops}) — the AUTHORITY for what a kill awards and drops (gADR-0004, gADR-0006); the builder resolves it into per-kind derived exp_reward/gold_reward/drop_table fields so the runtime stays a dumb kind.<field> read. `kinds` maps each Enemy Kind name to one point in Faction x Tier x Archetype plus its stat block (the same max_hp/max_mp/attack/defense shape as combat_config's stat_block — the symmetric damage-formula contract, gADR-0001), its blockout, and its Archetype-AI params. `waves` is the Wave schedule: the ordered list of Waves the level plays through, each Wave one Spawn Roster (the which-kind-spawns-where entries of gADR-0003); the wave COUNT is the array's length — config, never code. `spawn_squash`/`spawn_tween_duration` are the spawn-telegraph tween numbers (the wave system's juice, gADR-0005). Converted by scripts/build_config.py into one derived EnemyConfig .tres per kind (data/generated/enemy_<kind>.tres) plus data/generated/wave_schedule.tres (WaveScheduleConfig); the per-kind derivation specs are themselves derived from `kinds`, so adding a kind is a JSON-only change. Cross-field rules this schema cannot express — the Steering Band interval, the melee contact-damage bound, spawn->kind referential integrity across every wave, spawn-name uniqueness across the whole schedule, and Tier->reward coverage (every Tier a kind uses must have a `tiers` entry) — are enforced by build_config.validate_enemies_semantics before any resource is derived.

tier_reward.description: One Tier's Kill reward budget: the EXP and Gold awarded to the Player when an Enemy of this Tier dies (gADR-0004), plus the Tier's Drop table (gADR-0006) — the same per-Tier reward authority extended to drops.

exp_reward.description: EXP awarded per kill of this Tier; non-negative.

gold_reward.description: Gold awarded per kill of this Tier; non-negative.

drops.description: The Tier's Drop table: what a kill of this Tier may leave behind as Pickups (gADR-0006). May be empty (a Tier that drops nothing); each entry rolls independently.

drop_entry.description: One Drop-table entry: the item a Pickup carries, how much of it, and the independent probability the entry drops at all. Every item name has a pickup blockout style in progression_config.json's drop_items (all Phase-1 items required there — coverage by construction).

item.description: What drops: gold (accumulates onto the Player's Gold), or a Consumable item (bun/wine — counted by the S6b item hook; S7 owns their use-effects).

amount.description: How much one Pickup of this entry carries (gold value, or item count); a whole number, at least 1.

chance.description: Independent drop probability in (0, 1]: 1.0 always drops; a 0 chance would be dead config and is rejected.

rgba.description: A color as RGBA, each component in 0..1.

size2.description: A block size (width, height) in pixels; each strictly positive.

enemy_kind.description: One Enemy Kind: the three orthogonal taxonomy axes, the stat block (shape-compatible with combat_config's stat_block), the blockout, and the Archetype-AI params. Ranged kinds additionally carry their bolt's projectile_* block (enforced by the if/then below). A kind MAY carry the presence-gated Warp block (gADR-0009) — the warp_*/time_field_* params of the Boss's Warp kit, keyed to neither Tier nor Archetype; the dependentRequired map makes the block all-or-none.

faction.description: Visual-and-lore family axis (cosmetic and narrative only).

tier.description: Power-and-reward grade axis: drives the stat budget, and keys this kind's Kill reward in the top-level `tiers` table (gADR-0004).

archetype.description: Combat-style axis, driving AI behavior and attack delivery. Tank is representable but its AI behavior is deferred (gADR-0003).

max_mp.description: Maximum (and starting) MP; non-negative (enemies spend no MP in Phase 1).

attack.description: Attack stat fed to the symmetric damage formula when this kind attacks; non-negative.

defense.description: Defense/mitigation stat fed to the damage formula when this kind defends; non-negative.

move_speed.description: Horizontal steering speed in px/s; non-negative.

gravity.description: Downward acceleration in px/s^2 while airborne; non-negative (0 = floating kind).

max_fall_speed.description: Terminal fall speed in px/s; strictly positive.

aggro_range.description: Distance within which the Archetype AI activates (Aggro Range); strictly positive.

attack_range.description: Maximum distance at which an attack may fire; strictly positive. For melee kinds it must not exceed keep_range_max — melee damage is contact damage, gated to the point-blank band (enforced by build_config.validate_enemies_semantics; not expressible here).

keep_range_min.description: Steering Band lower edge: back off when the Player is closer than this; non-negative (0 = never back off, the Melee shape). Must not exceed keep_range_max (enforced by build_config.validate_enemies_semantics; not expressible here).

keep_range_max.description: Steering Band upper edge: close in while the Player is farther than this; strictly positive.

attack_squash.description: Visual scale punch at the moment of an attack (the attack-telegraph tween); each component strictly positive.

attack_tween_duration.description: Seconds for the attack squash to recover to normal scale; strictly positive.

projectile_speed.description: Enemy bolt travel speed in px/s; strictly positive.

projectile_lifetime.description: Seconds before an unhit enemy bolt despawns; strictly positive.

projectile_spawn_offset.description: Enemy bolt spawn offset (x, y) from the enemy origin; x is scaled by the aim direction's sign.

warp_cooldown.description: Seconds between Warp casts (gADR-0009); strictly positive.

warp_trigger_range.description: The Warp Blink fires only when the Player is FARTHER than this — the anti-kite engage gate. Must not undercut attack_range (the Boss never warps inside a brawl — enforced by build_config.validate_enemies_semantics; not expressible here); strictly positive.

warp_offset.description: Blink landing offset (x, y) from the Player's cast-time position; x is applied on the Player's far side from the Boss (cutting off the retreat, gADR-0009).

warp_tell_duration.description: Seconds of the charge-up tell before the blink — a Warp always telegraphs; strictly positive.

warp_recovery_duration.description: Seconds of the no-attack recovery window after landing (the fair-exchange window); non-negative.

time_field_radius.description: Time Dilation Field radius in pixels; strictly positive.

time_field_factor.description: The time scale applied to the Player's body sim and laser bolts inside the field, strictly inside (0, 1): 0 would freeze (a stun, rejected), 1 would be dead config, and the field never accelerates.

time_field_duration.description: Seconds the field persists after the blink drops it; strictly positive.

time_field_color.description: Time Dilation Field zone color (RGBA; alpha is the translucency of the overlay block).

time_field_fade_duration.description: Seconds of the field's spawn fade-in / expiry fade-out tween; strictly positive.

spawn.description: One Spawn Roster entry: which Enemy Kind spawns, under what node name, at what center position.

kind.description: The Enemy Kind key in `kinds` this entry spawns (referential integrity enforced by build_config.validate_enemies_semantics).

name.description: The spawned node's name; unique across the whole Wave schedule for addressability (enforced by build_config.validate_enemies_semantics).

wave.description: One Wave: a Spawn Roster spawned when the wave starts; waves advance in sequence as each is cleared (gADR-0005).

spawns.description: This Wave's composition: at least one spawn entry.

tiers.description: The per-Tier Kill reward table, keyed by Tier name (the same enum as a kind's `tier` axis). A subset is schema-valid; that every Tier actually USED by a kind has an entry here is a cross-field rule owned by build_config.validate_enemies_semantics.

kinds.description: Enemy Kind definitions, keyed by kind name.

spawn_squash.description: Visual scale a spawned enemy's block punches FROM at the moment it spawns (the spawn-telegraph tween, gADR-0005); each component strictly positive.

spawn_tween_duration.description: Seconds for the spawn squash to recover to normal scale; strictly positive.

waves.description: The Wave schedule: the ordered Waves the level plays through. The wave count is this array's length — reconfiguring to 3 or 5 waves is a JSON-only change (gADR-0005).
